info.name: GPlay Backend — DEV smoke tests
info.description:
Read-only smoke tests for the GPlay Cloud Functions on the DEV project (g-play-dd31d). Purpose: confirm the deployed functions respond correctly after the Node 22 + firebase-functions v7 / firebase-admin v13 upgrade. All requests here are READ-ONLY (no writes, no notifications, no charges).

Switch the {{baseUrl}} collection variable to the prod URL to test PROD instead.

Function types:
- onRequest: plain HTTP. POST + JSON body. Not auth-gated. (checkEmail, getUsersByLoginDate)
- onCall: Firebase 'callable' protocol. Body MUST be wrapped as {"data": {...}} and the response is wrapped as {"result": ...}. Most onCall functions require a Firebase Auth token; getUserData does not. (getUserData)

exec: // Healthy = HTTP 200 with an 'exists' boolean. This proves admin.auth()
// and admin.firestore() both work under firebase-admin v13.

request.description: Checks whether an email is already registered (Firebase Auth + Firestore 'user' collection). Use any email — an unused one returns {"exists": false, ...}. Required field: email. Optional: userId (to exclude a user from the check).

exec: // Healthy = HTTP 200 (a JSON payload of users). Proves Firestore
// paginated queries work under the new SDK.

request.description: Returns users from the 'user' collection (paginated). Optional body fields startDate / endDate (ISO strings) to filter by login date; null returns all. Read-only.
